name: Solar Wind
description: Stellar plasma outflow intelligence carrying magnetic field topology across interplanetary space. Shapes magnetospheres and drives space weather through particle flux dynamics.

core_attributes.pattern: coronal mass ejection, heliospheric current sheet, particle streaming

scope.definition: Accuracy of Parker solar wind model predictions for termination shock location — ratio of predicted to observed heliocentric distance of termination shock as measured by Voyager 1 and 2 crossings.

evidence.source: Parker (1958) 'Dynamics of the interplanetary gas and magnetic fields', Astrophysical Journal 128:664-676; Stone et al. (2005) 'Voyager 1 explores the termination shock region', Science 309:2017-2020.
cross_domain_examples: Parker model predicted termination shock at 75-90 AU; Voyager 1 crossed at 94 AU — 5-25% error
Voyager 2 crossed termination shock at 84 AU in southern hemisphere — asymmetry confirmed interstellar pressure effects
Earth's magnetopause: analogous bow shock location predicted by magnetohydrodynamics within 10%

scope.falsifiability: If Parker solar wind model predictions deviate from spacecraft observations by more than 50% at any measured heliocentric distance, the model requires fundamental revision.
scope.measurement_limits: Accuracy limited by interstellar medium pressure variability, solar cycle effects on wind density, and single-trajectory sampling by Voyager spacecraft. Uncertainty in ISM properties propagates to 20-30% model uncertainty.
